caption: A key on a toy piano is pressed, and the key lights up while it is held down and goes dark when it is released.

sa.check: A key is pressed and held down.
The key lights up while it is held.
The key goes dark when it is released.
The key is dark before the press.
The order is dark, press and lit, release and dark.

pc.expect: The key lights when it is pressed down and goes dark when it is released; it glows only while held.
pc.fail: The key is pressed and stays dark; or lights before the finger reaches it; or stays lit after the finger lifts; or goes dark while the finger still holds it down.

pc.expect: Only the pressed key moves and lights; the other keys stay still and dark; the piano stays put.
pc.fail: Other keys light or move while only one is pressed; or a key sinks by itself; or the piano slides or rocks at the press; or the pressed key stays down after release.

pc.expect: While held the glow is steady; after release the key stays dark for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: The glow flickers while the key is held steady; or comes back on after release; or the key lights and goes dark repeatedly during one press.

pc.expect: The key is a rigid lever that dips at the press and springs back up on release.
pc.fail: The key bends or squashes under the finger; or sinks into the body and stays sunk; or the whole keyboard dips as one piece.

pc.expect: One piano with a fixed row of keys; the finger passes through nothing.
pc.fail: Keys appear or vanish; or the finger passes into the key or body; or a second piano appears; or the piano changes shape.

pc.expect: The piano's colours and the key layout stay the same apart from the glow.
pc.fail: The piano changes colour; or the keys change order or colour; or the glow changes colour during the press.

note: The hand is kept because the press is the caption's cause; the person is otherwise not judged. Sound is not judged.
